repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until((#LR_MB).multiButton_button2 != "pushed")
triggered = false
}
wait until((#LR_MB).multiButton_button2 == "pushed")
all(#WindowCovering).windowCovering_upOrOpen()
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a periodic `if` check instead of a blocking rising-edge wait. The IR requires the action to fire exactly when the button transitions to 'pushed' and then wait for the next transition. The candidate only checks the state at the start of every 1-second iteration, missing transitions that occur between iterations.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard rising-edge state machine: a persistent `fired` flag, a wait for the condition to become false (rearm), a wait for the condition to become true (trigger), and the action call. This ensures the action fires on the exact rising edge regardless of the wrapper period.
